items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I heard people call him Horst and all that. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's what we used to call him.

ctx.x: Yeah, well we know it's man Manetta, see? We know it's man Manetta, see?

Well, I could say Bonito. I do get confused sometimes when people say Manetta. They couldn't call me Manetta, they call me Bonito. See, they give him that name, they couldn't say Manetta, they call me Bonito. I heard people call him Horst and all that.
Yeah, that's what we used to call him. Well, it's supposed to be like we told him Manetta, see? They couldn't say Manetta, so they called him Bonito.
